title: [Dev-i] Combo serial number detected as MAC address
body:
The new value "Serial Number" shown in Combo information tab is wrong. Is displaying my Combo MAC Address. 

Is it suppose to be the MAC address or serial number?

![Screenshot_20220417-094825](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/608650/163707589-817afcfa-2d65-485f-b697-da05dd2144f6.png)

comments.body: it's not possible to read SN from combo. This string is used internaly instead for password recovery
